newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai opens one of world's biggest libraries.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai opens one of world's biggest libraries.

text.p: Shanghai on Friday opened its new library, one of the 10 largest in the world and the third largest in Asia after Beijing and Tokyo, a library official said on Friday.
The library, costing 600 million yuan ($72 million), has 40 million books, the official said.
For decades, the library has been uncomfortably occupying the former clubhouse of the Shanghai racecourse, closed down when the Communists arrived in Shanghai in 1949.

The library is one of a number of municipal projects the Shanghai city government has undertaken in recent years as part of the grand plan to restore Shanghai to its position as one of the great cities of Asia.
New structures include the city hall, the Shanghai Museum and a historical museum.
